_comment: The size budgets and the performance/best-practices floors below are set just above what
the live site currently measures (audited 2026-08-30). They exist to catch NEW regressions,
not to describe a standard the site meets. Ratchet them DOWN as the site improves; never up.
Current reality driving these numbers: hero videos are autoplay with no preload hint, so a
visitor downloads 6.5 MB on /, 10.6 MB on /donate/, 11 MB on /volunteer/ (95 MB of .webm
site-wide). That is the root cause of total.size and of performance sitting at 0.68-0.73.
Fixing the video weight is the real work; these thresholds are the holding position.
